description: This file contains implementations for path and text parsing classes and methods within the WPEFramework project, specifically methods for parsing segments of text and file paths, including drive letters, file names, and extensions.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class providing methods to parse text segments with delimiters, supporting reading and skipping text.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class that parses a file path into drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename components.

methods.name: uint32_t ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[],const uint32_t offset) const
methods.description: Reads a segment of text until a delimiter or quote character is found.

methods.name: void ReadText(OptionalType<TextFragment> & result,const TCHAR delimiters[])
methods.description: Reads a segment of text into an optional TextFragment, using delimiters.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & input)
methods.description: Parses a text fragment to extract drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename.

ctags.name: ReadText
ctags.pattern: /^    uint32_t TextParser::ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[], const uint32_t offset) const$/
